name: Oxfam America
mission:
Oxfam is a global organization that fights inequality to end poverty and injustice. We offer lifesaving
support in times of crisis and advocate for economic justice, gender equality, and climate action. We
demand equal rights and equal treatment so that everyone can thrive, not just survive. The future is
equal.
theoryOfChange: Oxfam America has a published 'Oxfam America 2030 Strategy Framework (SUMMARY)' which lays out their core aspirations for the next decade and is complemented by three-year plans. This strategy was developed between 2018-2019 and approved by their Board of Directors in October 2019. The framework guides Oxfam America's work towards fighting inequality, addressing social injustice, and leveraging the influence of the U.S. for global good. Additionally, Oxfam America has developed a 'Corporate Inequality Framework (CIF)' to help investors analyze how companies contribute to inequality. They also have a rigorous monitoring, evaluation, and learning system for all long-term programs, major campaigns, and key innovation projects, which includes baselines, monitoring, and annual reviews.
